prompts.question: Who are you & what do you build?
prompts.answer: I'm yiğit — a machine learning and software developer building practical AI systems (computer vision, deepfake detection, on-device inference) alongside interactive, detail-obsessed web interfaces.

prompts.question: Tell me about Real, Deepfake or AI
prompts.answer: It classifies face images as real, AI-generated, or deepfake using ConvNeXt-Tiny 768-D features and a calibrated linear SVM (98.66% test accuracy across 11,493 images). The int8 ONNX model runs 100% locally in your browser via WebAssembly — nothing you upload ever leaves your device.

prompts.question: How is this website built?
prompts.answer: Zero frameworks and zero build step — plain HTML, CSS, and ES modules on Vercel. The Memoji head-tracking and cover-art Genie transitions run custom WebGL shaders, live music & film data syncs hourly from a homelab systemd timer into Supabase, and edge-cached Python /api functions serve it in milliseconds.

prompts.question: What's on repeat right now?
prompts.answer: Live top tracks, artists, 30-second previews, and all-time favorite albums synced from Spotify and Last.fm.

prompts.question: What have you watched lately?
prompts.answer: Recent Letterboxd diary entries, ratings, ticket stubs, watchlist picks, and all-time favorite films.

prompts.question: How can I reach you?
prompts.answer: The fastest way to see my work or reach out is on GitHub or LinkedIn.
